d:
The Election Commission of India has issued transfer and posting instructions ahead of the 2027 Assembly Elections. The directions cover Goa, Manipur, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand.
Officers who have completed three years in the same district or are posted in their home district may have to be transferred. The order covers officers connected with election-related departments, including administration, police, transport and excise. Why has the Election Commission issued these directions, and how can they help ensure free and fair elections?
